name: slidessoca
description: HTML slide decks on the dssoca design system — PowerPoint-style editor, Markdown import, auto-layout, 30-day share links.
author: Rafael Passoca

scripts.docker:start:prod: docker run --name slidessoca -d --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:3004:3000 -v slidessoca-data:/app/data -e ORIGIN=https://slides.passoca.dev $([ -f "$HOME/.slidessoca.env" ] && echo --env-file "$HOME/.slidessoca.env") slidessoca:latest
scripts.docker:stop:prod: docker stop slidessoca && docker rm slidessoca
scripts.docker:start:dev: docker run --name slidessoca-dev -d --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:3005:3000 -v slidessoca-dev-data:/app/data -e ORIGIN=https://slides-dev.passoca.dev $([ -f "$HOME/.slidessoca-dev.env" ] && echo --env-file "$HOME/.slidessoca-dev.env") slidessoca:dev
scripts.docker:stop:dev: docker stop slidessoca-dev && docker rm slidessoca-dev
